newsitem.title: USA: Presstek says U.S. will review patent claim.
newsitem.headline: Presstek says U.S. will review patent claim.

text.p: Presstek Inc said Wednesday the U.S. Patent Office has granted a request from an anonymous party to review one of its patents, a patent that Presstek said is "no longer fundamental" to its business.

Presstek said it has 48 patents issued and another four allowed in the U.S., containing almost 1,000 claims. None of its current products rely solely on patents being reviewed or reissued, Presstek said.
The company also said it will shortly begin construction of its 100,000 square foot manufacturing facility in Hudson, New Hampshire.
Presstek handles digital imaging and printing plate technology for printing and graphic arts industries worldwide.
